notes: On a failed save the creature is trapped in one of twelve extradimensional cells. A creature that knows the mirror’s nature has Advantage, and Constructs succeed automatically.
The mirror has AC 11, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage.
If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version doesn’t.
Cards are drawn at random from a 1d100 table (13-card or 22-card deck). The table lists only card names. Each card’s effect is a paragraph, so the effects are the item’s own.
Moon: “You gain the ability to cast Wish 1d3 times.” Wish is typed with group Moon, and its 1d3 castings are a use with count and spell.
Euryale gives a −2 penalty to saving throws while cursed, untyped. Fool gives Disadvantage and Jester Advantage on D20 Tests for 72 hours.
Skull summons an Avatar of Death, whose stat block is printed. Its damage is the creature’s, not the item’s.
Sun gives 10 Temporary Hit Points daily at dawn until you die, untyped.
uses stays untyped: Fates can be used once at any time before you die, and Sage’s one question must be asked within one year of drawing it. No use field holds that window.
You can breathe normally in any environment and have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
The necklace has 1d6 + 3 beads, each thrown as a Magic action up to 60 feet.
Throwing several beads at once increases the Fireball’s damage by 1d6 for each bead after the first (maximum 12d6). No field holds that increase.
The necklace has 1d6 + 3 beads, each spent when thrown. No field holds that count.

The necklace has 1d4 + 2 magic beads. Each bead’s type is chosen by the GM or rolled on a 1d20 table, and each bead’s spell is printed only in that table’s row (Cure Wounds as the level 2 version). Those spells belong to the rows, so none is typed on the item.

Each bead’s spell is cast as a Bonus Action, using your spell save DC. Once a bead’s spell is cast, that bead can’t be used again until the next dawn. Each bead has its own use and no one count holds them, so uses is untyped.
You must be wearing the necklace to use a bead.
